decisions.reason: Removing the Chinese Youku video does not change the existing Android size-optimization goal or its code-shrinking and unused-image-removal obligations; any possible size reduction is incidental and unspecified.
The removal applies to a specific Chinese Youku video integration and does not narrow or otherwise change the confirmed full-application localization coverage on Android.
The removed Youku integration was identified as an Android video behavior, and the source decision does not change iOS full-application localization.
